Why We Gather

To celebrate the season, connect with friends, and give back to our community. A portion of every transaction we take part in donates up to $900 to Seattle's Union Gospel Mission. Every holiday season we try to grow that impact with this event, helping deliver a calorie-rich meal to our neighbors in need.

$900Up to this much given per transaction
500+Sandwiches made each holiday season
$2.80Provides one meal at the Mission

Since 1932, Seattle's Union Gospel Mission has served neighbors facing homelessness with shelter, hot meals, recovery programs and housing support.

Last holiday season

Past Events

Long tables, red gingham, a lot of bread, and helpers of every age.

Where Your Sandwiches Go

The Mission's teams bring meals and care to neighbors on the street, in shelters and at holiday gatherings.

Why PB&J sandwiches?

They're a readily available source of calories and protein for people who are struggling with homelessness, hungry, and hurting in greater Seattle.
